- Size extra-extra-large: 4, 4b, 4b2, 13, 18, 31, 35 (7 items)

**Total before losing item: 1 + 7 + 4 + 2 = 14 items**

**Total after losing one extra-extra-large item: 14 - 1 = 13 items**

This count is the same regardless of which extra-extra-large item was lost.
